messages:
maria: Quick heads-up — draft internal announcement + release notes for tomorrow's 09:00 UTC deploy. Pls skim and flag anything risky.

maria: Draft release note below — trying to keep it short for the internal blast.
```
Release (2026-03-21) — rolling deploy, 09:00 UTC
- Model pin: gptx-2.1-pin-v3 (temporary pin to avoid kv-cache regressions)
- Feature: token-level latency telemetry now reported in Console per-route charts
- Perf: improved continuous batching heuristics (lower tail latency under burst)
- Fix: fallback routing bug under memory pressure (could cause 500s)
- Ops: default max_prefill reduced to 1024 to protect memory on large sequences
```

alex: LGTM. Suggest small copy change to the pin line: explain why we pinned and expected duration. Add: "pinned for 2 weeks while we validate quantization changes".

jamal: QA: I need one full regression run on canary before sign-off. ETA 3 hours from now. Will post results here.

sasha: Ops: runbook updated with rollback steps and thresholds (5% error increase OR 20% slower p95) — link: https://internal/runbooks/release-rollback

emily: Can we be explicit about which customers are on dedicated vs hosted? We should avoid accidental customer-facing wording. Internal blast should be "internal engineering and product" only.

maria: Good call, emily. I'll prefix the announcement with "Internal: engineers & product only — do not forward to customers."

ops-ryan: Ops notes: scheduling deploy at 09:00 UTC. Canary set to 5% traffic for 20 minutes, then 25% for 10m, then full if no alarms. Pinning config will be applied as part of k8s rollout (see snippet).

ops-ryan: ```yaml
# kustomize overlay snippet
- name: model.version
  value: gptx-2.1-pin-v3
- name: rollout.canary
  value: 5m
```

maria: Jamal, since you need a run, can we delay the internal blast until we have QA green? Or blast the draft to eng only with a note that it's "subject to QA"?

jamal: I'd prefer delay the blast. If we post now and then roll back, it causes confusion.

alex: Agree with jamal. Post after QA green. We can post a short pre-announce in #eng-releases an hour before if you want to remind folks.

maria: OK — plan: hold the internal blast until QA sign-off. I'll pin this thread and update the copy after jamal posts regression results.

deploy-bot: Canary deployment started on cluster-canary-1 at 1802003500. Tracking: https://deploys/internal/1802003500

jamal: Regression results: passed unit + integration + perf smoke. No error spike. p95 latency stable. QA sign-off ✅

maria: Awesome — thanks jamal. Final internal announcement copy below (internal only).
```
Internal: Engineers & Product only — do not forward to customers.

Release (2026-03-21) — rolling deploy, 09:00 UTC
- Model pinned: gptx-2.1-pin-v3 (pinned for two weeks while we validate recent quant changes)
- Feature: token-level latency telemetry visible in Console per-route charts
- Fix: routing fallback under memory pressure resolved
- Note: default max_prefill reduced to 1024 to reduce memory pressure

Rollout plan: 5% canary -> 25% -> full. Rollback triggers: +5% error-rate or +20% p95 latency vs baseline. Runbook: https://internal/runbooks/release-rollback

If you see anything odd after the canary, ping @ops-ryan and @sasha immediately.
```

ops-ryan: Announcement queued to send at 08:50 UTC to #eng-releases and #product. Deploy scheduled 09:00 UTC.

deploy-bot: Deploy scheduled for 1802004000 (09:00 UTC). Canary monitors: infra-alerts, request-errors, latency-regression.

maria: Thanks everyone — posting after QA was the right call. I'll follow up with a short post-deploy note once canary is clear. :thumbsup:

alex: +1

sasha: Standing by.

emily: Thanks team.

deploy-bot: Canary reached 25% at 1802003700. No alarms currently.

maria: canary OK -> proceed to full.

deploy-bot: Full rollout initiated at 1802003888.

ops-ryan: I'll keep monitors on until +2 hours. If anything trips, we rollback to previous revision and unpin.

maria: Filing final release notes to the release-notes repo now. Thanks all.
